t: What is the sum of first 24 terms of 2 + 4 + 4 + 7 + 8 + 10 + 16 + 13 + ....?
e: Let S = (2 + 4 + 4 + 7 + 8 + 10 + 16 + 13 + ....) Given series is a combination of A.P and G.P. and, Sum of first 24 terms = sum of first 12 terms of G.P + sum of first 12 terms of A.P Series in G.P = 2 + 4 + 8 + 16 + ... First term = a = 2 Common ratio = r = 4/2 = 2 n = 12 Then, sum = a(rn - 1)/(r - 1) = 2(212 - 1)/(2 - 1) = 8190 Series in A.P = 4 + 7 + 10 + 13 + ... First term = a = 4 Common difference = 7 - 4 = 3 n = 12 Then, sum = (n/2)(2a + (n - 1)d) = (12/2)(2 * 4 + (12 - 1)3) = 246 Therefore, sum of first 24 terms = 8190 + 246 = 8436

t: If the pth, qth and rth term of an arithmetic sequence are a, b and c respectively, then the value of [a(q - r) + b(r - p) + c(p - q)] = ?
e: a = A_1 + (p - 1)d ... (i) b = A_1 + (q - 1)d ... (ii) c = A_1 + (r - 1)d ... (iii) Eqn. (i) - (ii) a - b = (p - q)d => p - q = (a - b/d) Eqn. (ii) - (iii) b - c = (q - r)d => q - r = (b - c/d) Eqn. (iii) - (i) c - a = (r - p)d => r - p = (c - a/d) a(q - r) + b(r - p) + c(p - q) = a((b - c/d)) + b((c - a/d)) + c((a - b/d)) = (ab - ac + bc - ba + ca - cb/d) = (0/d) = 0

t: How many terms of the series -11, -8, -5, ......... must be taken so that the sum of all the terms is 9?
e:
Series given = -11, -8, -5, .........
Sum of the series = 9
Let n number of terms be taken.
By the formula of arithmetic progression,
9 = n/2 [2 * -11 + (n - 1) * 3]
9 = (n/2) [-22 + 3n - 3]
18 = 3n<sup>2</sup> - 25n
3n<sup>2</sup> - 25n - 18 = 0
3n<sup>2</sup> - 27n + 2n - 18 = 0
3n (n - 9) + 2 (n - 9) = 0
(n - 9) (3n + 2) = 0
n = 9 or -2/3 [n cannot be negative]
So, n = 9

t: The age of Atul, Vibha and Karan are in AP respectively. After two years, the age of Atul is one-third of the age of Karan and present age of Vibha is 3 years less than thrice of the present age of Atul. Find the sum of their current ages.
e:
Let the age of Atul, Vibha and Karan are (a - d), a and (a + d) respectively.
Now,
(a - d) + 2 = 1/3 * (a + d + 2)
a = 2d - 2 -----(1)
and
a = 3 * (a - d) - 3
2a = 3d + 3 -----(2)
From eqn (1) and (2) -
4d - 4 = 3d + 3
d = 7, a = 12
Sum of their current ages = a - d + a + a + d = 3*12 = 36 years

t: Third and sixth term of a Geometric Progression are 16 and 432 respectively. Calculate the sum of its first term and common ratio.
e: For the given Geometric Progression: Let first term = a And, common ratio = r Third term in geometric progression = ar2 = 16 a = 16/r2 Sixth term in geometric progression = ar5 = 432 Then, (16/r2) x r5 = 432 r = 3 Now, a = 16/(3 * 3) = 16/9 Therefore, a + r = (16/9) + 3 = 43/9

t: The 10<sup>th</sup> term of a geometric series is 8 times the 7<sup>th</sup> term of the series. If 5<sup>th</sup> term of the series is 80, then what is the 8<sup>th</sup> term of the series?
e:
The 10<sup>th</sup> term of a geometric series is 8 times the 7<sup>th</sup> term of the series.
=> ar<sup>9</sup> = 8 * ar<sup>6</sup>
=> r<sup>3</sup> = 8
=> r = 2
5<sup>th</sup> term of the series is 80.
=> ar<sup>4</sup> = 80
=> a * 2<sup>4</sup> = 80
=> a = 80/16
=> a = 5
Hence, 8<sup>th</sup> term of the series = 5 * 2<sup>7</sup> = 640
